testing_gaps: The latest-wins coordinator and runtime gate have deterministic unit coverage, but no test drives MainWindow autosave, stale error suppression, saved-destination labels, and watcher restart together through the WPF dispatcher; a wiring regression could therefore leave the UI showing a destination different from the persisted settings despite the coordinator remaining green.

Relocation cancellation is covered with a blocked worker and disposable local files, but real slow-network and cross-volume responsiveness, disconnection during enumeration or move, and packaged Stop behavior remain unverified, as the implementation progress document records.
